g.data-route: early second reading: the EP approved the Council position at first reading as agreed in trilogues

text.tspan: Procedure 2018/0328(COD). Route: early second reading: the EP approved the Council position at first reading as agreed in trilogues. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see eccc-regulation.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
